description: This file defines an Angular service 'AppStore' that manages application state for a planning app. It includes interfaces for domain models like requirements, architecture, resources, and milestones, and provides methods for CRUD operations, state persistence, and reactivity using Angular signals.

classes.name: AppStore
classes.description: Angular service that manages application state with signals, including persistence and CRUD helpers.

methods.name: addRequirement
methods.description: Adds a requirement to the state and persists if enabled.

methods.name: updateRequirement
methods.description: Updates a requirement by ID with provided patch.

methods.name: upsertRequirements
methods.description: Replaces or merges requirements by ID.

methods.name: updateArchitecture
methods.description: Updates an architecture item by ID.

methods.name: removeArchitecture
methods.description: Removes an architecture item by ID.

methods.name: updateResource
methods.description: Updates a resource item by ID.

methods.name: removeResource
methods.description: Removes a resource item by ID.

methods.name: setUiFlags
methods.description: Updates UI flags and persists if enabled.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the entire store to default state.
